recommendations.title: Refresh: Add a clear "Batteri utan solceller" decision guide
recommendations.details: Add a concise decision guide on the existing "Lönar sig ett batteri utan solceller?" page that helps homeowners decide whether to install a battery without solar. Include criteria (typical daily load profile, elavtal types like kvartspris, presence of effectavgift, local network tariffs), a short checklist of installation and regulatory requirements, and recommended next steps (measure consumption, book hembesök). Use plain language and examples tailored to Stockholm villas.

recommendations.title: Create: Include concrete cost examples and payback calculators
recommendations.details: Publish a short article or interactive calculator that shows 2–4 representative villa scenarios (e.g., låg-, medel- och högförbrukare) comparing battery economics with and without solar. Show purchase/installation cost ranges, potential intäkter (spotprisstyrning arbitrage, effektavgift reduction, stödtjänster) and resulting payback times under realistic 2026 price assumptions. Explain key sensitivities (battery size, elavtal, ability to deliver stödtjänster).
